name: Examinations, Marks, Report Cards & Academic Performance

features.name: Examination configuration: name, type, year, class, section or all, dates, scheme, instructions; deterministic id prevents duplicates; draft/scheduled/in-progress/completed/published/withdrawn/cancelled
features.evidence: examination.dart, exam_form_page.dart, exam_detail_page.dart; rules + contract + widget tests

features.name: Subject configuration: max, passing marks, weightage, date/time, theory + practical components; validated; counter moves with it
Grading schemes: bands, pass %, overall pass %, decimals, rounding, absent policy, aggregation, ranking, GPA only with grade points; overlap/gap validation
Scheme snapshot stored with finalised results; later scheme edits do not change report cards
features.evidence: finalize writes schemeSnapshot on exam and each result; rules require it

features.name: Marks entry: roster from enrolment, entered/absent/exempted/pending, zero distinct, bounds, components, remarks, search/filter, table and phone layouts, save draft, submit
Teacher authority from assignment slots; enrolment and class/section validated in rules
features.evidence: rules tests + mutants (slot, ACTIVE, class, section)

features.name: Marks history: every entry change appends a revision; sheet and exam history append-only
Review workflow: submit, approve, return with note; submitter cannot approve (school admin excepted); counters move with sheet in same commit
Central deterministic calculator: totals, %, grade, pass/fail, weighted %, GPA (only when defined), rank (only when enabled), provisional vs finalised
Finalisation: every sheet approved, complete marks required, next version, scheme + attendance snapshot, immutable create-only results
Publication: results-written check, one idempotent class/section notice per version
Withdraw, reopen and corrected new version with reasons; published results never overwritten
Report card on screen and PDF (print/download) from stored result with remarks, attendance snapshot, signature placeholders
Family portal: linked child's published results and report card, remarks, progress across same-scheme examinations
Academic performance: pass rate, average, grade distribution, subject table, support list; teachers see own subjects
Role dashboards with cross-examination aggregates and per-teacher pending entry summaries
features.evidence: status counts of loaded examinations + sheet lists only

features.name: Attendance summary on report card using attendance module definition
Arithmetic and completeness of results enforced by rules
features.evidence: client calculator + snapshot; trusted backend needed

features.name: Per-recipient notifications / push
Student login access to results
Cross-examination weighted term aggregates
features.evidence: weightage is per subject within one examination

features.name: Report card generation audit trail
features.evidence: document access is controlled; generation is on-device

commands.result: BLOCKED: iOS 26.5 platform not installed in Xcode

security_verification: Tenant and branch isolation tested with direct reads/writes (School B admin, South branch admin/teacher, finance).
Only administrators configure, review, finalise, publish, withdraw, reopen and cancel; teachers and parents cannot, even with a correct history record.

Marks only by the ACTIVE assignment-slot teacher (or an administrator), for a student ACTIVE in that year/class/section, while marks entry is open and the sheet editable; bounds, absent/exempted semantics and component sums enforced.
Approver cannot be the submitter (school admin excepted); approval and return move the exam's counter in the same commit.
Results are create-only, version-matched, never updated or deleted; marks are frozen outside marks entry for everyone.
Parents read only a linked, portal-enabled, ACTIVE child's result, only while PUBLISHED and only the version in force; never marks, sheets, remarks, history or schemes.
Publication notice tied to the publish commit and unique per version; a retry cannot duplicate it.
Mutation check: 42 mutants, 40 killed, 2 equivalent (redundant by construction). Dart-written documents replayed through the real rules for the whole lifecycle including correction.
bugs_found_and_fixed: Calculator crashed for an entry with components but no stored total (effectiveMarks added).
A 'Result' tile overflowed on narrow screens (fixed-height tiles removed).
Subject dialog was empty when class subjects had not loaded (readAlive).
PDF used a dash glyph the built-in font lacks (ASCII-only text).

Rules: sheet changes were allowed after marks entry closed; any active user could update an examination; subject could be added without its counter; zero maximum accepted; principal remark could be written by a class teacher on first write; class of the student not checked — all found by the mutation check and fixed with tests.
Test helpers silently ignored mis-shaped overrides (caught by naming each expected denial).
unresolved_issues: Rules cannot verify totals, grades or result completeness: results are calculated by the administrator's client (single calculator + stored scheme snapshot). A modified administrator client could write wrong figures or publish with results missing; a trusted backend would be needed.

A teacher of the branch can read any published result of the branch; any parent of the school can read a published examination's configuration. Results, marks and remarks of a child are link-protected.
Marks batches are five entries per commit (partial drafts possible, never a partial submission).
Families see the child's current class only; earlier classes are not looked up.
No student login, no separate approver role, no per-recipient notifications, no cross-examination term aggregates, no report card generation audit, Latin-1-only PDF text, no logo.
No end-to-end run against real Firebase; 5 new indexes unexercised; iOS build blocked by the environment.
Dashboards are partial (counts of loaded examinations, performance, family page).
